about:
I am the Co-Founder of Field, a design-led Shopify Plus agency dedicated to building high-performance digital experiences for the UK’s most ambitious D2C brands.

I’m heavily involved in our design output—overseeing everything from brand and UI/UX to CRO. My job is to make sure every project we deliver isn't just visually striking, but is meticulously engineered to drive ROI. From the initial onboarding to final delivery, I work closely with our clients to help translate their brand heritage into a modern digital flagship.

We’re lucky enough to work with some of the UK’s best-known D2C brands, including Percival, Schoffel, David Austin Roses, This Works, and UK Lash.

If you’re looking to scale a brand on Shopify Plus or want to talk design-led e-commerce, feel free to get in touch.
